basic_info.description: Welcome to this move-in ready Candlestick Point 2-bed/2-bath condo conveniently located within minutes from Highway 101, without fighting a lot of local traffic! The strategic location enables the owners to easily commute to the heart of San Francisco job centers, or even shorter drive to bio-tech jobs in South Francisco. It's a gated community so it's very safe. It's located on the 3rd floor, so it does not get as hot as the top-level units in the summer. The unit has brand new WPC vinyl floors so it's very easy to maintain. Brand new carpet in the bedrooms. Brand new paint throughout the house. Granite countertops with newly painted cabinets! Great open floor concept. Primary bedroom has an en-suite bathroom and ample closet space. 2-bedroom unit allows for flexibility in getting additional room rental income for an owner if he/she so chooses. The HOA at $783 a month for this unit is low compared to others in the same community since the owner has just completely paid off about $33K worth of one-time special assessment that some owners pay on a monthly basis.
